final_verdict: CASCADE DOES NOT REUSE PREVIOUS PROJECT KNOWLEDGE

evidence_items.description: Triple-layer tenant/workspace/project isolation in schema. All 20 tables have project_id FKs. No cross-project FKs exist.
Every pipeline query filters by project_id + tenant_id. Worker extracts project_id from current job, never queries other projects.
persist_understanding_graph and persist_geometry_model both query by project_id == project_id AND tenant_id == tenant_id.
.storage/ mock S3 encodes project_id in every filename. storage/projects/ uses per-project UUID directories.
evidence_items.source: Filesystem scan of .storage/ (27 files) and storage/projects/ (3 directories)

evidence_items.description: Verified zero vector stores, embedding DBs, similarity indexes, or model caches exist anywhere in the project tree.
No memory files, session state, or cross-project state mechanisms exist.

excluded_by_mission_rules: test_plan.png (shared test fixture, not project data)
why_no_learning_possible: Cascade has NO mechanism to learn from previous projects because: (1) Every DB table is project-scoped with no cross-project FKs; (2) Every query in the pipeline filters by current project_id; (3) Storage is namespaced by project UUID; (4) No vector stores, caches, or memory files exist. Cascade processes each project as a completely independent pipeline run using only shared source code and configuration.
